name: Idol Yukiho no Kankin Rape!
original_name: アイドル雪歩の監禁レイプ!
source:
Yukiho is abducted on her way home from school!
They put her in a soundproof room with no phone, internet or
abiility to reach the outside world...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ110425.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
雪步在放学回家的路上遭到绑架！
绑匪将她关进一间隔音房，里面没有电话，没有网络，
也没有任何能与外界取得联系的办法…

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ110425.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
